summary: First end-to-end test of the HomeServe CUSTOMER mobile app at 390x844. Backend untouched; frontend-only test. ALL REQUESTED FLOWS PASS. Login: customer-login-phone-input (9800000001) -> customer-login-send-otp-btn -> wrong OTP 9999 shows 'Incorrect OTP' error toast; correct 1234 verifies and lands /home (demo mode banner shown). Session persists on hard reload of /home. Tabs tab-home/tab-bookings/tab-wallet/tab-profile all render; i18n Hindi switch flips tabs to होम/बुकिंग/वॉलेट/प्रोफ़ाइल and back to EN. Home: home-location-selector opens location sheet (location-add-address-link, location-use-gps-btn present; GPS tap opens location-permission-sheet - web fallback OK). home-search-input + submit navigates to /services?q=cleaning (9 chips, 3 cards). home-banner-slider renders. category-* (8) tap -> /services?category_id=cat_ac (chips 9, cards 2). trending-add-* (6) adds to cart and home-view-cart-btn sticky bar appears. Book-again shown. Services: services-chip-* filter chips (9), service-card-* (2), service-add-* (2), services-view-cart-btn - all working. Service detail /service/serv_ac_01: addon-* (2), qty-plus-btn/qty-minus-btn/qty-value, service-detail-total updates 549 -> 1098 on qty+. service-detail-add-btn + service-detail-checkout-btn work. Address flow: profile-add-address-btn -> /address with address-label-home/office/other (3 chips), address-line-input + address-pincode-input (226010 Lucknow serviceable), address-save-btn saves and returns to profile. Checkout: checkout-address-* (1) selectable, mode toggle instant/scheduled works (5 slot-date-* + 7 slot-time-* when scheduled), 4 coupon-chip-* chips (FIRST50/SAVE100/ACFEST/QATEST10), coupon code via input + apply works (surge/GST breakdown appears), pay-upi/pay-card/pay-wallet/pay-cod all tappable, checkout-price-breakdown present. Place-order via pay-upi (Razorpay empty -> demo mode) creates booking and navigates to /booking/bk_a61f6d656c5b with HS753037 PENDING + tracking-finding-partner banner. Tracking: tracking-status/tracking-stepper/tracking-finding-partner/tracking-cancel-btn all present initially. After admin reassign (POST /api/admin/bookings/{id}/reassign with admin token - 200 ok to partner usr_demo_partner Ramesh Kumar), reload shows tracking-partner-card, tracking-start-otp (1034), masked-call-btn + tracking-chat-btn. chat-dialog with chat-input + chat-send-btn works; masked-call-dialog opens on tap. tracking-cancel-btn -> cancel-confirm-sheet -> confirm-cancel-btn -> tracking-cancel-info shown and booking status -> CANCELLED (visible in Bookings tab). Completed booking (HS892484): tracking-invoice-btn opens invoice-dialog (GST breakdown), tracking-rebook-btn present, booking shows 'You rated 5★' so rate-card/stars are hidden (expected - rate only shows for unrated). Bookings tab shows 25 items with 25 bookings-rebook-* buttons. Wallet: wallet-balance ₹0 -> wallet-topup-500 -> ₹500, wallet-txn-* count 1. Profile: profile-name-input, profile-email-input, profile-save-btn works ('Language updated' toast on save), 3 profile-notif-* toggles, profile-address-delete-* present, profile-help-btn + customer-logout-btn work (logout clears session, redirects to /login). Support: support-seg, chatbot-input + chatbot-send-btn -> 'I need refund help' got reply about wallet refunds; chatbot-raise-ticket-btn only shows for certain queries (did not surface for refund query, but logic appears intent-based). Demo payments working: UPI/Card simulated (status payment_mode:'demo', booking goes straight through), Wallet real (debits balance; returns 400 if insufficient balance - correct), COD real.

minor.issue: Wallet payment with insufficient balance returns 400 'Insufficient wallet balance' - correct backend logic, but the frontend UI should disable or warn before user taps place-order (currently user sees generic error toast). Could also auto-hide pay-wallet option when total > balance.

ui_bugs.issue: Users can select pay-wallet even when wallet balance < total, leading to a 400 'Insufficient wallet balance' only after tapping place-order. Suggest disabling/greying pay-wallet or showing inline 'Insufficient balance - top up ₹X' hint under the option.

issues: The sticky 'Pay ₹X' bottom bar (checkout-place-order-btn) occasionally reports 'Element is outside of the viewport' on Playwright click - works via force click/JS click. On real small devices the button sits in the safe area; keep an eye on bottom insets and ensure the button has enough bottom padding above the home-indicator.

react_native_issues.issue: Multiple 'shadow*' style props deprecation warnings on every screen on web. Use 'boxShadow' or Platform.select. Reference: likely /app/frontend/src/ui.tsx or theme.ts.

'useNativeDriver is not supported because the native animated module is missing. Falling back to JS-based animation.' - gate useNativeDriver with Platform.OS !== 'web'. Reference: /app/frontend/src/ui.tsx.
'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' - move to style prop. Reference: likely /app/frontend/src/ui.tsx (Overlay/Modal backdrop).

action_items: FIX: On checkout, if wallet_balance < total, visually disable pay-wallet row or show 'Insufficient balance (short by ₹X)' inline so users don't hit the 400 only after tapping Place order.
CLEANUP: Replace deprecated RN-web style props - shadow* -> boxShadow, props.pointerEvents -> style.pointerEvents.
CLEANUP: Gate Animated useNativeDriver on native only (Platform.OS !== 'web').

NICE-TO-HAVE: chatbot intent for 'refund' currently answers inline without surfacing chatbot-raise-ticket-btn - consider surfacing the raise-ticket shortcut on every answer so users can always escalate.
NO BLOCKER - all requested flows are working end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: routes_customer.py create_booking is clean - validates payment_method, cart, address, coupon, serviceable pincode, slot (when scheduled), wallet balance, then persists booking + wallet_txn + coupon used_count. Online payments (upi/card) create a razorpay order; when keys are empty, demo mode kicks in with payment_mode='demo' and booking proceeds (as intended for this preview).
AuthProvider rehydrates session before rendering children - verified via hard reload of /home remaining logged in.

Checkout sticky 'Pay' CTA uses a fixed bottom bar - good UX, but keep bottom insets consistent with the (tabs) layout (tab bar is NOT present on /checkout, so the overlap seen in the admin app is not an issue here).

success_rate.backend: Not re-tested exhaustively this iteration (frontend-only request). Verified live: /api/auth/otp/send, /api/auth/otp/verify (demo 1234), /api/admin/auth/admin/login, /api/admin/partners, /api/admin/bookings/{id}/reassign (200), /api/customer/bookings POST (success via UPI demo and expected 400 for insufficient wallet).

Service detail (addons, qty, total, add/checkout) PASS. Address (labels, line, pincode 226010, save) PASS. Checkout (address, instant/scheduled slots, coupon input+apply, coupon-chip, pay-upi/card/wallet/cod, price breakdown, place-order via UPI demo) PASS. Tracking (status/stepper/finding-partner/cancel on PENDING; partner-card/start-otp/masked-call+dialog/chat+dialog+input+send after admin reassign; cancel-confirm-sheet+confirm-cancel+cancel-info; invoice-btn+invoice-dialog and rebook-btn on COMPLETED) PASS. Bookings tab (25 items + rebook) PASS. Wallet (balance+topup+txn) PASS. Profile (name/email/save, lang HI/EN with Hindi tab labels, notif toggles, address-delete, help, logout) PASS.
